run_make_video_from_image_dirs: run make_video.py to stitch image sequence directories into a side-by-side MP4 video
run_make_video_with_diff: run make_video.py with --add_diff to generate a difference overlay between two image sequences
run_make_video_custom_grid: run make_video.py with --columns to arrange multiple image sequences in a custom grid layout
run_make_video_with_gap: run make_video.py with --gap to add pixel spacing between video panels in the grid
run_make_video_frame_range: run make_video.py with --start and --end to encode only a subset of frames
